title: Keith house's south corner turns in stone, as photographed
items: At 1808 Prairie Avenue the granite front now turns the south corner as a straight strip of the same coursed stone, about 2 m deep, from the ground to the parapet. The brick side wall starts behind it.
It replaces the toothed corner stones that were laid into the brick. The Reed photograph of 1941 and a mid-1950s view both show the strip, and the downpipe in the 1950s view marks where it ends.
